title: Creature materials: per-creature hit/death sounds and hit dust (blood, gel, bone, sparks)
player_outcome: Every creature sounds and bleeds like what it is: slimes squish and spray gel in their own colour, skeletons clack and shed bone chips, mechs clang and spark, zombies spill blood, plants shed leaves. Damage-over-time ticks no longer spam hit sounds.
design: Verified: SoundEvents.cs:141 plays 'hit' for every creature. Death is a hard-coded switch (:145). EnemyDef.HitSound/DeathSound are unused. The DoT tick (NpcSystem.cs:161) raises a normal DamageEvent. hit_squish is unused.
Pre-split: move NpcSystem.Kill (with drops/coins) and the DoT block into a new NpcSystem.Death.cs; NpcSystem.cs is at 378 lines.
Add Dictionary<long, Npc> ById maintained on Spawn/Remove and a Find(id) method.
DamageEvent gains NpcId (long, default 0) and Kind (DamageKind: Hit | Periodic | Player | Heal | Mana). The DoT tick sends Periodic; ReportPlayerDamage sends Player.

New data/config/creature_materials.json. Each material (flesh, gel, bone, metal, plant, stone, spirit, chitin) has hitSound, deathSound, dust {recipe: Chips/Dust/Sparks/Leaves, color, useTint}, gore {pieces, color, shape}. A Core Presentation/CreatureMaterialsConfig.cs loads and validates it (every enemy material exists; recipes known) from ValidateCommand and GameRoot.

New game/Audio/SoundEvents.Creatures.cs: on a Hit event with an NpcId, play Def.HitSound ?? material.hitSound at the position (throttled 45 ms per material); skip Periodic. On Killed, play Def.DeathSound ?? material.deathSound (bosses +4 dB). The hard-coded switch is removed.

New game/Entities/CombatEffects.Dust.cs: on a Hit, EffectKit.Burst(material recipe, npc centre biased toward the attacker, colour = useTint ? Def.Tint : material colour, count = min(12, 4 + dmg/10) × EffectsScale).

Data pass (scripted in-session): set 'material' on all 225 enemies from their model (gel/king_slime/queen_slime → gel; skeleton/cursed_skull/skeletron*/bone models → bone; probe/mech/martian/destroyer/prime → metal; man_eater/plantera/mourning_wood/everscream → plant; granite/golem → stone; wraith/ghost/pixie/dungeon_spirit → spirit; hornet/beetle/antlion/moth → chitin; else flesh). Review bosses by hand.
